_meta.purpose: ADS-3A.2 product enrichment: metadata of the items advertised by the Ads fixture campaigns
_meta.source: latest live channel_api_snapshots row of v2.product.get_item_base_info per item, for the 101 Ads-referenced items of the ADS-1A shop (the real API returned every one of them)
_meta.note: Sanitized PROJECTION of real responses: only the fields ADS-3A.2 reads are kept (item_id, item_name, item_sku, item_status, image, has_model, create/update_time); item ids remapped order-preserving onto the masked item ids of the exp-* Ads fixtures (not reversible); names / SKUs / image ids replaced by placeholders; image arrays truncated to the first image; statuses, ratios, timestamps and value types untouched. The live URL shape https://cf.shopee.vn/file/<image_id> (no query string) was verified on 657/657 real snapshots.
